info.description: The Loyalty Expiration Management API provides a means to retrieve information on loyalty programs and their expiration statuses. This endpoint allows businesses to check which loyalty points or rewards are nearing expiration, facilitating better customer engagement and retention strategies. Typical consumers of this API include marketing teams and customer service representatives who aim to enhance customer experiences by proactively informing them about their loyalty benefits. By managing loyalty expirations effectively, organizations can improve customer satisfaction and encourage repeat business.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information about loyalty points that have expired. Use this to manage customer accounts and inform clients about their loyalty status.

requestBody.description: Request body to specify the parameters for expiring loyalty points. This includes detailed information needed to process the expiration of loyalty points for a user or account.
